answer: Like basalt bedrock under a canyon, a refundable stake escrow anchors each agent identity: to join the economy an agent locks a deposit that is returned only after a history of honest, attested work. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately, so the cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once and keep trading. Misbehavior slashes the stake, so a comet-fast flood of sock-puppets burns capital faster than it can earn, while the escrow stays neutral — it prices identity, it does not judge content.
